changes: Notes expanded: the era is not named in the colophon (only 'saṃ') and is taken as NS from the Newari script and the catalogue field; also noted the colophon's text name differs from the catalogue title.

notes: The colophon says only 'saṃ 981'. NS is assumed from the Newari script and the catalogue's (NS) reading, which gives 981 + 880 = c. 1861 CE. 'vaddhi' stands for vadi (kṛṣṇapakṣa). The catalogue field gives (NS) 891 (c. 1771 CE), but the quoted colophon reads 981. One of the two is probably a transposition error, and the colophon reading is preferred. The colophon names the text 'padmapurāṇīyatarppaṇavidhiḥ', not Guhyakālyayutākṣarī as in the catalogue title. This may be a closing section or another text in the same manuscript. No persons are named.
